description_en: Queries node type information, including the type code and type name
description_zh: 查询节点类型信息，包括类型Code和类型名称
name: GetNodeTypeListInfo

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can view the ID on the workspace management page by clicking the wrench icon in the upper-right corner
parameters.help_zh: Dataworks工作空间的ID，您可以单击页面右上角的小扳手图标，进入工作空间管理页面进行查看
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the DataWorks workspace, which is the English identifier displayed when you switch workspaces at the top of the Data Studio page. You must specify either this parameter or the ProjectId parameter to determine the DataWorks workspace for the current API call
parameters.help_zh: Dataworks工作空间的唯一标识符，即数据开发页面顶部切换工作空间处的英文标识。该参数与ProjectId参数二者必须设置其一，以确定本次API调用操作的Dataworks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en: The page number of the requested data
parameters.help_zh: 请求的数据页数，用于翻页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 请求的数据页大小，最大值为100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the node type. You can view the node type name in the Data Studio directory tree. Both Chinese and English are supported, and the language must match the value of the Locale parameter. Fuzzy search is supported. If this parameter is left empty, all node types are returned
parameters.help_zh: 节点类型的名称，您可以在DataStudio目录树中看到某个节点类型的名称，支持中英文，与locale需要对齐。支持模糊搜索，不填的情况下返回所有节点类型
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The language filter. Valid values: zh-CN and en-US
parameters.name: locale

NodeTypeInfoList.description_en: The list of node type information that matches the query conditions
NodeTypeInfoList.description_zh: 符合条件的节点类型信息列表

NodeTypeInfo.description_en: The information about a single node type

NodeType.description_en: The numeric code of the node type

NodeTypeName.description_en: The name of the node type

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the current page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries that match the query conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足查询条件的数据总条数

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues if an error occurs
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用的唯一ID。出现错误后，您可以根据该ID排查问题
